column1: # rosetta-corpus.tsv -- the MANIFEST of the Rosetta corpus (tools/rosetta-corpus; docs/rosetta-plan.md section 2).
# NAMES AND DIGESTS ONLY.  Rosetta Code's text is GFDL 1.2: no program and no expected output is
# ever checked in.  `tools/rosetta-corpus build` rebuilds the corpus from the commit below and
# `verify` compares it with this file; a row changes only with a new commit or a new rule, by edit.
# MADE s543o (2026-11-27) from the corpus blessed 2026-11-24 (the s493 selection, re-admitted by
# reproduces byte for byte; TWO ROWS LEFT BY EDIT, because their expectation is not a fact of
# the program -- 0359-Distinct-palindromes-within-decimal-numb prints one of two outputs, half
# and half over 8 runs (hash order: its 2 + 3 admission runs agreed by chance), and
# 1442-Text-to-HTML's output holds the date of its bless (its three runs fell inside one
# second).  The build's drift pass refuses both.
